lines: Every rifle on the line is a real player. Now, every shot can hit one.
Hit someone, and it goes in both your records.
Ten trades, and every one matters.
Snipers pick targets. Machine guns pin men down. Stretcher bearers save lives.
Sappers mend the wire. Cooks keep spirits up.
Every day makes you better. Recruit. Seasoned. Veteran. Elite.
The badly wounded need a bed. Each side has just two.
When they fill, men wait in the mud.
Lost? Follow the red cross on the map. Tap the arrow, and you're there.
So each side votes what to build. A hospital, or sandbags.
Fall, and your house fights on. Your heir takes the rifle.
The longest alive. The best shots. It's all in the Ranks.
Comment Concord, or Hegemony. Your front needs you.
